verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of NVLink, Infinity Fabric, or rack-scale multi-GPU deployment for the RTX PRO 6000 — only PCIe Gen5 and MIG partitioning are mentioned, which are workstation-class features, not datacenter interconnect. Community evidence (comm-4) explicitly notes these cards are SM120 workstation parts 'so no tmem/tcgen05 and lack of support in main libraries,' with users suggesting a datacenter-class B300 instead for true multi-GPU scale-out, confirming this card is not positioned for rack-scale training/serving.
